finalMessage:
`slugify("Crème brûlée")` now returns `"creme-brulee"`.

The fix is in `src/index.js`. `slugify` normalizes the input to NFD, which splits accented letters into a base letter plus a combining mark, and then removes the combining marks. The existing separator regex then sees plain letters. I also added the `"Crème brûlée"` case to `test/index.test.js`.

The test file passes (2/2), and the output matches the expected value. A broader `node --test test/` run failed, but that was because I passed the directory path, which Node tried to load as a file. Running the test file directly is the valid check.

I did not commit anything.
